mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month does not lead to negative 5-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) over three months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS shows a sustained decline over three months but does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in > 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals strengthening supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% in 1 month does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) and decrease in Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals strengthening economic demand and labor market health, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition of HOUST increasing and UNRATE decreasing does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in one month signals a loosening monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases > 0.25% in 1 month does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in one month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS decreases > 100,000 in 1 month does not lead to negative 5-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals strengthening economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 shows a sustained increase over two consecutive quarters but does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in > 50% of instances.
